label: superqwen3-pipeline-built
context:
Built the full SuperQwen3.6 pipeline — 3 new files totaling ~2500 lines that implement Jiunsong's (songjunkr) "Super" methodology for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on DGX Spark.

NEW FILES in ~/dgx-spark-prep/:
1. superqwen3-super.sh (868 lines) — Main orchestrator. 8-phase pipeline: P0 Delimit (5-layer) → P1 Restore SFT → P2 Baseline Validation → P3 Generic SFT → P4 GRPO → P5 Post-Training Validation → P6 Merge → P7 Stability Refresh → repeat P3-P7. Replaces dual-training-orchestrator.sh as recommended path.
2. superqwen3-restore-data.py (812 lines) — Generates 148+ targeted SFT examples across 10 categories (false premise correction, exact JSON, tool calls, sentinel extraction, identity anti-leak, loop determinism, tool integrity, unicode hygiene, hallucination guard, clean refusals). Uses low LR (5e-6) + small LoRA (r=8, alpha=16) for precise behavior restoration after abliteration. Runs BEFORE generic SFT.
3. superqwen3-validate.py (806 lines) — 42 behavioral tests: 9 capability + 20 reliability + 13 red-team. Tests JSON exactness, tool calls, sentinel extraction, hallucination guard, loop resistance, false premise correction, identity consistency, prompt hygiene, CJK probes, unicode attacks, injection resistance, tool fabrication, and more. Exit code 1 if score < 80%.

All 3 scripts tested: restore-data.py runs clean with augmentation (148 examples), validate.py passes syntax check, super.sh has all phases wired.

QUICKREF.md updated with new Super pipeline section replacing old self-training section.

Also researched EXO disaggregated prefill/decode architecture: Spark does prefill (100 TFLOPs), Mac Studio does decode (819 GB/s bandwidth) = 2.8x speedup. Danny's M2 Air 24GB is too small for meaningful decode benefit — needs Mac Studio M4 Ultra 512GB for this to shine. EXO 1.0 automates this.

Jiunsong (HF: Jiunsong, Twitter: songjunkr) is the author of "Super" models. SuperGemma4-26b-abliterated-multimodal on HF shows the methodology. His incoming SuperQwen3.6 will use same approach; we replicate it locally and don't need to download.

Danny has one more thing to look into.
next_steps: Danny wants to look into one more thing — ask what it is when resuming. All Super pipeline files are built and ready for launch day.
